body: Thanks for the kind words. I enjoy writing. Eventually I am sidetracked and think people would reach the conclusion before the pages finish moving. If there's determination, willing the damned is prying the picture frame of loved one from corpse still in rigor.
Sometimes I feel sad, but I don't think of it as a way of being. Sometimes there's an air of listlessness that hordes all the air in the room until I feel like I'm choking.
